subject: PPAP target configuration requirements clarification
purpose: Record user-confirmed decisions for the future target technical specification; preserve the OOTB baseline separately.
precedence: Use current confirmed decisions and exclude superseded decisions. Explicit source-rule overrides govern the target where earlier ADRs or the initial solution brief differ.

decisions.topic: First release scope
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Core PPAP with those extensions deferred (Recommended)
included: PPAP-side connections to PCR and inspections
constraints: Preserve existing APQP behavior when changing shared components.
Treat connected-application connections as PPAP-side interfaces; do not infer authorization to implement entire connected applications.
Operational BOMEX/ECS integration timing is governed by PPAP-INT-001.

decisions.topic: Operational BOMEX/ECS intake for the first release
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Automated intake in the first release, with controlled manual initiation as a fallback (Recommended)
requirements: Automatically receive applicable BOMEX/ECS changes in the first PPAP release.
Create source-linked initial drawing-review records from the automated intake.
Support controlled manual initiation as a fallback.
constraints: Preserve the existing Product Integration application's isolated business-object boundary.
Define the operational connection needed for PPAP separately; do not assume that isolated intake already supplies operational PPAP relationships or triggers.
Detailed payload mappings, manual-initiation permissions, and fallback reconciliation remain design or subsequent clarification work.

decisions.topic: Manufacturing facility and shipping depot scope
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: One manufacturing facility, with shipping depots linked separately (Recommended)
requirements: Scope each PPAP approval to one manufacturing facility.
Link shipping depots separately as context for the PPAP and its task routing.
constraints: A shipping depot does not replace the manufacturing facility as the approval scope.
Do not require a separate PPAP solely because the same manufacturing facility uses a different linked shipping depot.
Preserve the governed SRM supplier-entity and role-resolution rules when implementing depot links and task routing.

decisions.topic: Governing model and manufacturing-stage context
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: One model/program and one manufacturing stage per model-change PPAP (Recommended)
requirements: Each model-change PPAP has one governing model/program and one manufacturing stage.
Calculate model-change task dates from that governing context using the model schedule and applicable element offsets.
constraints: Do not assign several independently governing model/stage schedules to a single model-change PPAP.
Running-change and process-change PPAPs remain independently scheduled unless explicitly connected to a model-change context under ADR-101.

decisions.topic: Interim and conditional approval
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Full approval only; omit Interim Approval (Recommended)
requirements: Require full PPAP approval; do not provide interim or conditional approval.
Omit the OOTB Interim Approval stage and its entry and exit actions from the target PPAP workflow.
constraints: Reconcile PPAP-specific interim-approval fields, phase values, progress calculations, views, notifications, reports, and other dependencies in the target change specification.
Preserve the separately retained OOTB baseline and existing APQP behavior.

decisions.topic: Cancellation of an issued PPAP
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Engineer or PPAP administrator may cancel, using those controls (Recommended)
requirements: The responsible PPAP engineer or a designated PPAP administrator may cancel an issued PPAP.
Require a cancellation reason and retain the actor and cancellation time.
Stop outstanding PPAP element work and reminders when cancellation completes.
Preserve the PPAP's evidence and complete decision history.
Expose the cancelled PPAP outcome to linked PCR/APQP work and flag it for the responsible owner's resolution; do not treat cancellation as successful fulfilment.
constraints: Do not require a separate cancellation-approval workflow.
Do not automatically cancel an entire originating PCR or APQP solely because a linked PPAP was cancelled.
Approval withdrawal after final closure is outside the first release under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-003.
Eligibility of previously approved elements from cancelled PPAPs is governed by PPAP-EVIDENCE-002.

decisions.topic: Withdrawal of approval after closure
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Do not support approval withdrawal in the first release
requirements: Exclude post-approval withdrawal functionality from the first PPAP release.
constraints: Do not introduce a first-release approval-withdrawal action, workflow, or withdrawal-driven certificate-verification state.
Preserve the original approved package and evidence unchanged.
Cancellation of issued work under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 does not authorize cancelling an approved, closed PPAP.
Create a new PPAP for applicable engineering changes under PPAP-CHANGE-001, whether a prior PPAP is open or closed; retain closed-package immutability.

decisions.topic: Compatibility and version selection for evidence reuse
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Same facility/drawing/element, with engineer-confirmed revision and part compatibility (Recommended)
requirements: Restrict evidence reuse to the same manufacturing facility, drawing, and governed element type.
Require the responsible engineer to confirm that retained evidence is suitable for the receiving PPAP's drawing revision and selected part scope.
Suggest the latest eligible approved evidence version.
Permit the engineer to select a different eligible approved version with a mandatory reason.
constraints: Do not require an identical drawing revision or identical selected part set when the engineer confirms compatibility.
Do not support cross-facility or cross-drawing reuse under this policy.
Copy retained evidence into the receiving PPAP's immutable task-level snapshot while preserving source lineage under ADR-023.

Cancellation effects on evidence eligibility are governed by PPAP-EVIDENCE-002. Engineering changes require a new PPAP under PPAP-CHANGE-001; the earlier engineering-reopening scenario in PPAP-EVIDENCE-003 is superseded. Reuse during non-engineering evidence correction is governed separately by PPAP-EVIDENCE-004.

decisions.topic: Evidence eligibility after source PPAP cancellation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Exclude approved evidence from cancelled PPAPs from future reuse (Recommended)
requirements: Exclude evidence whose source PPAP is cancelled from future reuse, even when that element was individually approved before cancellation.
Apply the exclusion to both automatic suggestions and manual selection of retained evidence.
Collect and approve a fresh submission in the receiving PPAP when no eligible prior evidence is available.
Preserve existing historical snapshots and source lineage.
constraints: Do not introduce an administrator-revalidation exception to the cancelled-source exclusion in the first release.
The prospective reuse restriction does not authorize deletion or alteration of historical evidence or withdrawal of a closed PPAP approval.

decisions.topic: Evidence eligibility while an approved element is reopened
decisions.supersession_reason: The user clarified that an engineering change starts a whole new PPAP and never reopens an approved element in the existing PPAP. The scenario underlying this earlier answer does not apply to the target.
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Keep the last approved snapshot eligible, subject to compatibility checks (Recommended)
requirements: When an approved element is reopened for an engineering change while its PPAP remains open, retain its last approved evidence snapshot as eligible for reuse elsewhere.
Apply the manufacturing-facility, drawing, element-type, revision, and selected-part compatibility rules in PPAP-EVIDENCE-001.
Make a replacement submission eligible for reuse only after that replacement is approved.
constraints: Reopening an element does not erase or alter its prior approved snapshot or approval history.
The cancelled-source exclusion in PPAP-EVIDENCE-002 continues to apply and takes precedence if the source PPAP is cancelled.
Selection of an eligible approved version other than the suggested latest version continues to require a reason under PPAP-EVIDENCE-001.

decisions.topic: Draft visibility, issue, and supplier scope confirmation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Internal drafts; explicit issue; supplier confirms scope before its first element submission (Recommended)
requirements: Keep draft PPAPs internal and unavailable to supplier users.
Require an explicit engineer issue action before releasing the PPAP to the supplier.
Require the supplier to confirm the manufacturing facility, drawing, and included part numbers before its first supplier element submission.
constraints: Apply ordinary supplier-entity and record-classification security after issue; issue does not grant access outside authorized scope.
The supplier confirmation requirement governs supplier element submissions and does not prevent authorized internal element work.
Post-issue scope is locked under PPAP-SCOPE-003; scope changes require cancellation and replacement.

decisions.topic: Scope immutability after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Lock facility, drawing number, and part scope; cancel and replace the PPAP if scope changes
requirements: Lock the manufacturing facility, drawing number, and included part-number scope after the PPAP is issued.
Require cancellation of the issued PPAP and creation of a replacement PPAP when any of those scope values must change.
constraints: Do not provide a post-issue part-scope amendment action, including an administrator override, in the first release.

Engineering changes and associated drawing-revision changes requiring PPAP start a new PPAP under PPAP-CHANGE-001; do not absorb them into an issued PPAP merely because the facility, drawing number, and included parts are unchanged.
Apply cancellation controls under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 and draft/issue/supplier-confirmation controls under PPAP-RELEASE-001 to the replacement process.
Apply the cancelled-source evidence exclusion under PPAP-EVIDENCE-002; replacement does not make evidence from the cancelled PPAP eligible for retained reuse.

decisions.topic: Authority for safety, quality, and regulated classifications
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Imported drawing/part classifications are authoritative; no PPAP-level overrides (Recommended)
requirements: Use the authoritative drawing/part classifications supplied through operational integration for important-safety, important-quality, and regulated requirements.
Do not permit PPAP-level classification overrides.
Block issue until missing or conflicting classifications are resolved.
constraints: Do not interpret a missing classification as an explicit confirmation that no classification applies.

These rules concern important-safety, important-quality, and regulated classifications, not the separate security visibility classification. Governed new-model/mass-production visibility handover under ADR-084 remains applicable.
Resolve classification corrections through the authoritative source and operational integration rather than an override on the PPAP.
Mixed-part aggregation is governed by PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-002; post-issue classification changes are governed by PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-003.

decisions.topic: Aggregation of classifications across included parts
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Combine applicable requirements; any important-safety part triggers management approval (Recommended)
requirements: Combine all applicable evidence requirements arising from the classifications of the included parts.
Require overall management approval whenever at least one included part has the important-safety classification.
constraints: Important-quality or regulated classifications alone affect evidence requirements and do not independently activate overall management approval.
Do not require separate PPAPs solely because the included parts have different classifications.
Use authoritative imported classifications without PPAP-level overrides under PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-001.

decisions.topic: Authoritative classification changes after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Cancel and replace the issued PPAP when classifications change
requirements: Require cancellation and replacement of an issued, open PPAP when its applicable authoritative classifications change.
Initialize the replacement PPAP using the current authoritative classifications and their combined evidence and approval requirements.
constraints: Do not implement in-place post-issue classification reassessment as an alternative to cancellation and replacement.
Draft preparation may incorporate updated source classifications before issue; no cancellation is required solely to refresh an unissued draft.
Preserve previously closed approvals unchanged; post-approval withdrawal remains outside the first release.
Apply cancellation and replacement controls under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 and PPAP-RELEASE-001, including the cancelled-source evidence exclusion under PPAP-EVIDENCE-002.

decisions.topic: Authority for the requirement library and template matrix
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Use SIA's current IntelliQuest library/procedure as the authority; map and reconcile OOTB content (Recommended)
requirements: Use SIA's current IntelliQuest requirement library and PPAP procedure as the authoritative source for the initial target requirement library and template matrix.
Map and reconcile the OOTB elements, checklist content, level templates, routing, and classification defaults against that authoritative source.
constraints: Do not treat the OOTB catalogue as the authority when it differs from the current controlled SIA requirements.
Preserve source traceability for retained, modified, added, or retired OOTB configuration.

required_inputs.description: Current controlled SIA PPAP procedure, IntelliQuest requirement library, and applicable template/classification matrix.
required_inputs.user_answer: Record the source material as pending and continue
required_inputs.handling: Continue clarifying business rules; retain this input as outstanding for source-backed catalogue and template reconciliation.

decisions.topic: Requirement exclusions and protected applicability
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Engineer may exclude unprotected requirements with a reason; protected requirements remain mandatory (Recommended)
requirements: Permit the responsible engineer to mark an unprotected default requirement Not Required during PPAP setup, with a mandatory reason.
Keep requirements mandated by the controlled SIA procedure or applicable classifications protected from waiver.
Allow suppliers to request N/A for engineer review; suppliers cannot waive requirements themselves.
constraints: Do not require a separate administrator-approval workflow for an engineer's permitted exclusion of an unprotected requirement.
Determine the actual protected requirement set through the source-backed reconciliation under PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-001; PPAP-INPUT-001 remains outstanding.
Post-issue element and applicability changes are governed by PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-003 and require cancellation and replacement.

decisions.topic: Requirement-set immutability after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Lock the requirement set at issue; cancel and replace for additions or exclusions
requirements: Lock the PPAP requirement set and element applicability when the PPAP is issued.
Require cancellation and replacement of an issued PPAP when an element must be added or excluded, including changing an existing element to Not Required.
constraints: Do not provide an in-place post-issue requirement-set amendment action.

Allow correction, resubmission, and authorized reopening of existing required elements for evidence correction or internal management feedback, while the locked scope, classifications, and requirement set remain unchanged. Engineering changes instead require a new PPAP under PPAP-CHANGE-001.
Evaluate a supplier's N/A request through the engineer: an accepted request that changes issued applicability requires cancellation and replacement rather than an in-place waiver.
Apply PPAP-SCOPE-003, PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-003, and PPAP-CHANGE-001 when distinguishing permitted evidence correction from changes that require a replacement or new PPAP.

decisions.topic: Part-level mass data and validation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Require both masses for every part, in kg, using those validation rules (Recommended)
requirements: Require average actual mass and average metal mass for every included part before final submission.
Capture both values in kilograms.
Validate average actual mass as greater than zero.
Validate average metal mass as greater than or equal to zero and less than or equal to average actual mass.
Treat zero average metal mass as an explicit confirmation that the part has no metal content.
constraints: Keep unknown mass values missing; do not default unknown values to zero.
Do not permit N/A to bypass either required mass value for an included part.
The final mass-data gate is separate from the scope confirmation required before the first supplier element submission under PPAP-RELEASE-001.

decisions.topic: Calendar basis and initial drawing-review target
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Calendar days; initial drawing review due after 14 calendar days (Recommended)
requirements: Use calendar-day arithmetic for PPAP task-date offsets in the first release.
Set the initial drawing-review target to 14 calendar days after drawing release.
constraints: Do not apply working-day or holiday-calendar adjustments to these first-release calculations.
Keep date-change audit, PPAP schedule disconnection/reconnection, and overdue-date warnings under ADR-101 and ADR-108.

decisions.topic: Date recalculation and preservation of issued baselines
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Update open connected work only; preserve issued baselines and completed history (Recommended)
requirements: Apply model-driven effective due-date recalculation only to open work on schedule-connected PPAPs.
Preserve the original issued planned-date baseline when model schedules subsequently change.
Preserve completed task and closed PPAP date history unchanged.
Keep manually assigned dates on disconnected PPAPs unchanged until an authorized reconnection.
constraints: Do not overwrite an original issued baseline with the latest model plan.
Continue to audit effective date changes and warn before schedule disconnection/reconnection under ADR-101 and ADR-108.
Supplier timeliness deadline comparisons are governed by PPAP-METRIC-001; submission-event and detailed scorecard mapping rules remain separate clarifications.

decisions.topic: Element due-date completeness before issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Require due dates for all required elements before issue, and allow already-overdue dates with a warning.
requirements: Require every required PPAP element to have a calculated or manually assigned due date before issue.
Permit issue when one or more required element due dates are already overdue, while displaying a warning.
constraints: Block issue for missing required element dates, not merely because a populated date is in the past.
Apply the date-completeness gate to both supplier-facing and internal required elements.
Preserve the calendar-day and issued-baseline rules under PPAP-SCHEDULE-002 and PPAP-SCHEDULE-003.

decisions.topic: Inspection and run-at-rate approval gates
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Only explicitly required inspection/run-at-rate results gate approval (Recommended)
requirements: Require engineer-accepted results for inspection or run-at-rate activities explicitly required by the PPAP's elements.
Keep the corresponding required element incomplete until its required result is accepted.
constraints: Do not impose a blanket PPAP approval gate requiring closure of every linked pilot program, inspection, or failure.
Other linked pilot work does not automatically block PPAP approval solely because it remains open.
Use PPAP task/evidence handling for first-release run-at-rate requirements; the dedicated TACT-TRI build remains deferred under PPAP-SCOPE-001.
Retain PPAP's approval-orchestration boundary; detailed measurement execution remains in the applicable inspection process or specialist tool.

decisions.topic: Pilot program applicability by PPAP context
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Pilot programs are new-model only; other PPAPs use inspection elements and linked results/evidence (Recommended)
requirements: Limit Pilot Part Data program creation to new-model PPAPs.
Handle running-change and process-change inspections through the applicable PPAP inspection elements and linked inspection results or evidence, without creating pilot programs.
constraints: Apply the required-result approval gates under PPAP-INSPECTION-001.
Retain the new-model Pilot Part Data boundary in ADR-098; the broader running-change pilot-program wording in ADR-039 does not govern this target scope.
This decision does not expand the PPAP data model to capture detailed measurements.

decisions.topic: Engineer eligibility for final management approval
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Allow the engineer to provide final approval if they belong to the eligible approver pool
requirements: Allow the responsible PPAP engineer to provide final management approval when that person belongs to the governed eligible approver pool.
Apply the same governed pool eligibility checks to the engineer as to any other final approver.
constraints: Do not enforce a different-person separation rule between the responsible engineer and the final management approver.
Do not skip or automatically complete the important-safety management approval stage solely because the engineer is an eligible approver.
Retain the explicit final approval decision and actual actor history under the established PPAP approval controls.

decisions.topic: Engineer review of self-completed internal elements
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Allow the engineer to approve their own completed internal elements (Recommended)
requirements: Permit the responsible PPAP engineer to approve an internal element that they personally completed.
Retain the completion and review decisions and actual actor history.
constraints: Do not require a different-person peer-review step solely because the responsible engineer completed the internal element.
Supplier-completed elements continue to require internal engineer review.
Self-review eligibility does not bypass required evidence, protected requirements, or overall PPAP completion gates.

decisions.topic: PPAP eligibility for Service Parts Only suppliers
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Allow service-related PPAPs only for Service Parts Only suppliers (Recommended)
requirements: Allow suppliers in Service Parts Only status to participate in PPAP work specifically covering service parts.
Keep new mass-production PPAP work blocked for those suppliers under the central supplier-status capability rules.
constraints: Apply existing supplier-entity scope, company/facility lifecycle restrictions, user permissions, and record-classification security in addition to the service-work eligibility rule.
Preserve historical visibility under the existing central policy; service-work eligibility does not broaden historical or cross-supplier access.
Continue to use the central open-work/status-transition policy rather than introducing automatic PPAP cancellation on supplier-status changes.

decisions.topic: Reminder and escalation defaults
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Use those configurable reminder and escalation defaults (Recommended)
requirements: Notify the current assignees 3 calendar days before the applicable due date and on the due date.
Send weekly reminders to current assignees while work remains overdue.
Escalate supplier work after 7 calendar days overdue to the responsible PPAP engineer.
Escalate internal work/review and final approval after 7 calendar days overdue to designated PPAP administrators.
Make reminder intervals, escalation thresholds, and recipients configurable.
constraints: Notifications and escalations do not automatically reassign or cancel work.
Use the current applicable work/stage due date for reminders while preserving the independently retained issued baseline and date history.
Review-stage turnaround targets are governed by PPAP-REVIEW-001.

decisions.topic: Engineer and management review turnaround targets
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: 5 calendar days for engineer review and 5 for management approval (Recommended)
requirements: Set the initial engineer-review target to 5 calendar days from each element submission or resubmission.
Set the initial final-management-approval target to 5 calendar days from submission or resubmission of the completed PPAP for that approval.
Make both review targets configurable.
constraints: Missing a review target triggers reminders and escalation under PPAP-NOTIFICATION-001 and does not automatically approve the work.
Retain prior submission, review, return, and date history when a new review cycle starts.
Keep internal-review deadlines distinct from supplier submission commitments and performance measurements.

decisions.topic: Approval authentication and signing requirements
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Authenticated approval and audit history; no additional signing step (Recommended)
requirements: Use authenticated Intelex approval actions with recorded actor, timestamp, decision, and audit history.
Do not require an additional electronic-signature or reauthentication step in the first release.
constraints: Continue to enforce governed approver eligibility, evidence completeness, protected requirements, and all other approval gates.
The absence of an additional signing step does not remove the explicit element or final approval decision.
Final certificate generation must reflect the actual recorded approval rather than implying approval before the action completes.

decisions.topic: Supplier approval outputs and evidence downloads
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: PDF certificate plus individual authorized files; defer consolidated package download (Recommended)
requirements: Provide a controlled PDF approval certificate in the first release.
Allow individual evidence-file downloads only where the supplier user is already authorized to access those files.
constraints: Defer consolidated approved-evidence package download from the first release.
Certificate and file access must continue to enforce supplier-entity scope, record classification, and internal/supplier visibility restrictions.
Do not expose internal-only evidence or management exchanges through supplier download features.

decisions.topic: Immutability of posted discussion content
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Append-only posts and attachments; corrections use new replies (Recommended)
requirements: Make posted PPAP discussion comments and their attachments append-only.
Require corrections to be made through new replies rather than editing or deleting the original post or its attachments.
Allow users to prepare a post before submission; the append-only restriction applies after posting.
constraints: Preserve the original post, author, timestamp, attachment context, and discussion visibility controls.
Do not provide ordinary post-edit or post-delete actions after submission.
Discussion availability after PPAP closure is governed by PPAP-DISCUSSION-002; first-release retention is governed by PPAP-RETENTION-001.

decisions.topic: Discussion availability after approval or cancellation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Make all discussion read-only after approval or cancellation
requirements: Make all PPAP discussion read-only after the PPAP is approved or cancelled.
Apply the closure restriction to both internal SIA and supplier users, including new threads, replies, and discussion attachments.
constraints: Do not provide an internal-only post-closure discussion exception in the first release.
Preserve authorized access to existing discussion under supplier-entity, record-classification, and lifecycle rules.
Keep posted content append-only under PPAP-DISCUSSION-001 while the PPAP remains open.

decisions.topic: Operational PPAP migration scope
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: New ppaps only
requirements: Start with new PPAPs in Intelex only.
Exclude migration of active legacy PPAP workflows, historical approved packages, and the legacy approved-evidence baseline from this build.
constraints: Retain legacy work and history outside the scope of this Intelex PPAP implementation.
Build the Intelex reusable approved-evidence baseline through new submissions and approvals; do not assume a migrated legacy baseline is available for the first PPAPs.
Continue source-backed reconciliation of the SIA requirement library and templates under PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-001; configuration reconciliation is distinct from operational PPAP migration.
Preserve automated operational BOMEX/ECS intake under PPAP-INT-001; the new-only decision does not remove that integration requirement.

decisions.topic: First-release retention behavior
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: We should use that approach
decisions.confirmed_interpretation: Retain PPAP records and evidence with no automatic deletion in the first release.
requirements: Retain PPAP records, approved and rejected evidence, discussions, and certificates without automatic deletion in the first release.
constraints: Do not configure an automatic retention purge using an assumed duration or starting event.
A later deletion or archival policy requires an explicit controlled SIA retention rule; no legal retention period is inferred by this decision.
Continue to enforce existing evidence immutability, discussion restrictions, and authorized historical access.

decisions.topic: Deadline bases for supplier timeliness reporting
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: We should use both
requirements: Report supplier on-time performance against the original issued baseline.
Also report supplier on-time performance against the operational due date in effect when the supplier submits.
Preserve both deadline comparisons as distinct reportable measures.
Freeze the applicable operational due date with its submission so later date changes do not rewrite that submission's history.
constraints: Preserve the original issued baseline under PPAP-SCHEDULE-003.
Do not select either deadline basis as the sole reporting measure.
Do not infer scorecard weighting or double-counting from the requirement to expose both measures.
The supplier submission event to measure is governed by PPAP-METRIC-002.

decisions.topic: Supplier submission event used for timeliness
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: I agree with your recommendation
decisions.confirmed_interpretation: Use the first complete supplier submission for timeliness and report rejection/rework separately.
requirements: Use the first complete supplier-element submission that passes the required-field and file checks as the supplier submission event for timeliness reporting.
Apply both deadline comparisons under PPAP-METRIC-001 to that submission event.
Report rejection and rework separately from the initial supplier timeliness measure.
constraints: Do not substitute the engineer's approval timestamp or a later accepted resubmission timestamp for the first complete supplier submission.
Continue to retain subsequent submissions, decisions, and review history.

Engineering changes start a new PPAP with its own submission metrics under PPAP-CHANGE-001; an engineering-driven element-reopening metric cycle is not required. Cancellation treatment is governed by PPAP-METRIC-003.

decisions.topic: Engineering changes initiate a new PPAP
decisions.source: User correction in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Actually ...there won't ever be a scenario where an engineering change reopens an approved element. An engineering change would actually trigger a whole new ppap
requirements: When an engineering change requires PPAP, initiate a whole new PPAP rather than reopening approved elements in an existing PPAP.
Apply the new-PPAP rule whether the earlier PPAP is still open or has already closed.
Retain the earlier PPAP's engineering context, evidence, decisions, and metric history.
Give the new PPAP its own source engineering context, issue/confirmation process, and submission metrics.
constraints: Do not create an engineering-driven reopening/commitment cycle inside the earlier PPAP.
Eligible prior approved evidence may be reused under PPAP-EVIDENCE-001 and PPAP-EVIDENCE-002; the new-PPAP rule does not waive compatibility or cancelled-source exclusions.
Retain the initial drawing-review determination and governed no-PPAP exceptions; this correction replaces the absorption behavior when a new engineering change requires PPAP.
Do not use addressed by another PPAP to absorb a different new engineering change into an existing open PPAP.
Evidence correction and management Return for More Information remain distinct from engineering changes and may follow their existing element-review controls.
An older open PPAP normally continues to completion for its original revision under PPAP-CHANGE-002; do not cancel it automatically.
supersedes: Earlier in-flight engineering-change constraints in PPAP-SCOPE-003 and PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-003

source_rule_overrides.rule: Absorb later engineering changes into an open PPAP and reopen affected elements
source_rule_overrides.target_disposition: Superseded by new PPAP creation; closed-package immutability remains applicable.

source_rule_overrides.rule: Use addressed by another PPAP to absorb a later ECS as supplemental engineering context in an open PPAP
source_rule_overrides.target_disposition: Superseded for a different new engineering change requiring PPAP; the initial drawing-review gate and no-PPAP exceptions remain applicable.

source_rule_overrides.source: solution-brief.md, Engineering changes and concurrent work
source_rule_overrides.rule: An ECS arriving during an open PPAP becomes supplemental context and reopens affected elements
source_rule_overrides.target_disposition: Superseded by this user clarification for the future target specification.

decisions.topic: Disposition of an older open PPAP after a new engineering change
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: In all likelihood it would still be completed. In edge cases the engineer would require a Cancel PPAP workflow option
requirements: Normally continue an older open PPAP to completion for its original engineering revision when a new engineering change initiates another PPAP.
Provide an engineer-accessible workflow action labelled Cancel PPAP for edge cases where the older PPAP should not continue.
Apply the cancellation permissions and mandatory-reason/history controls under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002.
constraints: Do not automatically cancel the older PPAP when the newer PPAP is created.
Do not retarget the older PPAP to the new engineering revision; preserve its original scope and engineering context.
Continue to permit concurrent PPAPs under the agreed explicit-scope and human-sequencing policy.
The cancelled-source evidence exclusion remains applicable if the engineer or authorized administrator does cancel the older PPAP.
